source_metadata.title: Neuropsychiatric adverse drug reactions in children initiated on montelukast in real-life practice

notes: The main-text matched-cohort and supplementary unmatched post hoc estimates were retained as distinct assertions because they use different analysis populations.
The correction statement was retained as publication-history context rather than altering historical claims elsewhere.

extraction_limitations: The source is a retrospective, single-center publication with supplementary tables; atomization preserves reported evidence but does not establish causality.
Conflict-of-interest details were not reproduced in the evaluated PDF beyond a pointer to disclosures alongside the article, so no conflict_of_interest atom was created.
Reference-list entries were treated as provenance/queue infrastructure and were not atomized as primary evidence.
schema_gaps: The schema has no dedicated publication-correction atom kind; the correction was represented as atom_kind=other with publication-history tags.
